name: Ichijodani Castle (Asakura site)
description: Ichijodani was the 15th-16th century castle town of the Asakura clan, Japan's most fully excavated Sengoku city, designated a special historic site. The castle ruins crown the valley, with the town's garden sites preserved below.
notes: The reconstructed town quarter (Fukui Prefectural Ichijodani Asakura Family Site Museum) is paid; castle ruins are free.

ja.name: 一乗谷城
ja.description: 朝倉氏が五代にわたって栄えた一乗谷の城と城下町。戦国時代の都市遺構として日本随一の国特別史跡です。
ja.notes: 復元町並みは福井県一乗谷朝倉氏遺跡資料館の有料エリア。城跡は無料です。
